entries.1a8b4b22cf279898: As its medium-term management strategy, the company indicates a policy of, while continuing its business for new housing, focusing further on its strong business for existing housing and existing buildings. In the construction work business, it will work on taking orders for comprehensive repair work for building exteriors and strengthening its ability to handle large buildings, and, in cooperation with the building maintenance business, lead from exterior wall diagnosis to proposals and orders for repair work; in the real estate business, it states that it will also develop land sales and purchase and regeneration of used houses and condominiums.
